checks.name: The database is stopped at once under an open note: the supervisor notices, restarts the runtime with its database, and reports ready again by itself
The words typed while the database was gone stayed in the editor and were saved after it came back; the acknowledged words are intact
checks.savedBy: itself, when the library was back

checks.name: Words left unsaved at quit while the library was away are not lost: they are a retained draft, and the reopened note says so and opens the retained drafts
After a restart the note reads the same, revision included, and writing works; a clean quit leaves nothing running

afterQuitWithUnsavedWords.offeredOnScreen: Could not save: The library did not answer. It restarts by itself and your words are sent again then. Your words are kept as a retained draft. RetryDiscard unsaved edits

limits: One machine, one run, one note. The database is stopped with pg_ctl in immediate mode on the profile's private directory, which ends it the way a crash does; a disk failure or a corrupted cluster is not produced.
